defs.def: new information about sth that has happened recently 消息；音信

ex.s: I gave the owner as much information as possible and headed home to see what news the night might bring.
ex.t: 我向主人尽可能多地提供了信息，然后朝家走去，看看那个夜晚会带来什么消息。

ex.s: What if the only way of getting news from far away friends was writing letters that took ages to be delivered?
ex.t: 如果从遥远的朋友那里获得消息的唯一方法是写信，而这些信件需要很长时间才能送达，那该怎么办？

ex.s: Shortly before her sixteen birthday, she is shocked by the life-changing news that she is the princess of a fictional kingdom called Genovia.
ex.t: 在她十六岁生日前不久，她被一个改变人生的消息震惊了：她是一个叫做吉诺维亚的虚构王国的公主。

ex.s: From Andrew To Matt Subject Travel arrangements Hey Matt, Good news for our trip!
ex.t: 发件人：安德鲁 收件人：马特 主题：旅行安排 嘿马特，我们旅行有好消息！

ex.s: Finally, we may also tell a white lie when we want to protect others from bad news.
ex.t: 最后，当我们想保护他人免受坏消息伤害时，我们也可能会说善意的谎言。

ex.s: How would you expect others to truly understand your emotions if you only shared good news instead of bad?
ex.t: 如果你只在网上分享好消息而不是坏消息，你怎能指望别人真正理解你的情绪呢？

ex.s: I ran back to Gunter and told him the bad news.
ex.t: 我跑回冈特那里，告诉了他这个坏消息。

ex.s: I ran back to Gunter and told him the bad news.
ex.t: 我跑回冈特那里，告诉了他这个坏消息。

ex.s: A few weeks later, when I almost forgot the contest, there came the news.
ex.t: 几周后，当我几乎忘记这场比赛时，消息传来了。

ex.s: A few weeks later, when I almost forgot the contest, there came the news.
ex.t: 几周后，当我几乎忘记这场比赛时，消息传来了。

ex.s: The good news is that when that happens, we pick ourselves up, brush ourselves off, and get back to work.
ex.t: 好消息是，当失败发生时，我们会重新站起来，拍掉身上的灰尘，继续工作。

ex.s: The good news is that it’s simple to learn and can be worth the effort.
ex.t: 好消息是学习起来很简单，而且值得付出努力。

ex.s: But good news is that there’re really only three kinds of decisions you need to make about color in your home: the small ones, the medium ones, and the large ones.
ex.t: 但好消息是，关于家里的颜色，你真正只需要做三种决定：小的、中等的和大的。

ex.s: And, even if I weren’t  43  enough about free credits, news about our  44   was appealing enough to me.
ex.t: 而且，即使我对免费学分不够____43____，关于我们____44____的消息也足够吸引我了。

ex.s: Here's the good news.
ex.t: 这是个好消息。

ex.s: The good news is that there is evidence we can learn to change our own story.
ex.t: 好消息是，有证据表明我们可以学会改写自己的人生故事。

ex.s: The good news is that I can help my own kids learn earlier than I did how to live more with less.
ex.t: 好消息是，我能帮助自己的孩子比我更早学会如何用更少的东西生活得更好。

defs.def: reports of recent events that appear in newspapers or on television or radio 媒体对重要事情的报道；新闻

ex.s: That’s bad news for the environment — and our wallets — as these outdated devices consume much more energy than the newer ones that do the same things.
ex.t: 对环境来说这是个坏消息——对我们的钱包也是如此——因为这些过时的设备比做同样事情的新设备消耗更多的能源。

ex.s: Magazines and newspapers provide adults with critical news.
ex.t: 保留有趣的杂志图片给孩子提供故事灵感。

ex.s: ● If your news station or school requires interviewees to sign release forms to appear on the air, don’t leave work without them.
ex.t: ● 如果你的新闻台或学校要求受访者在出镜前签署免责声明表格，没有完成这项工作就不要离开。

ex.s: He's a news reporter.
ex.t: 他是一名新闻记者。

ex.s: While running every aspect of our own news station, kids and their fellow campers will create and host a broadcast airing each night at dinner for the entire camp.
ex.t: 在运营我们自己的新闻站的方方面面的同时，孩子们和营友将制作并主持每晚晚餐时播出的节目，面向整个营地。

ex.s: Run a news station.
ex.t: 运营一家新闻站。

ex.s: Become the next star reporter, news writer, director or producer.
ex.t: 成为下一代明星记者、新闻撰稿人、总监或制片人。

ex.s: She wanted mom to read the news to her．
ex.t: A．她想让妈妈给她读新闻。

ex.s: However, psychologists have demonstrated that when adults read news stories, they remember more of the content than if they listen to or view identical pieces.
ex.t: 然而，心理学家已经证明，当成年人阅读新闻故事时，比起聆听或观看相同的片段，他们对内容的记忆更多。

ex.s: I have good news to tell you．
ex.t: 每段对话结束时，会针对所说内容提出一个问题。

ex.s: The news on TV.
ex.t: 这位男士仍然有工作。

ex.s: Bitcoin and other so called crypt currencies have been all over the news lately.
ex.t: 比特币和其他所谓的加密货币最近充斥着新闻。
